sections.st: Ampoule & Vial Trays Manufacturer India — PETG Trays, GMP Cleanroom · Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures ampoule and vial trays from our Cleanroom Class 8, GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom PETG thermoformed secondary packaging trays for the complete ampoule and vial pharmaceutical range. Ampoule vial trays manufacturer from Vapi for pharmaceutical companies, contract manufacturers, and pharma exporters. As an ampoule vial trays manufacturer from India, we supply PETG ampoule and vial secondary packaging trays for domestic pharma and for export.

Ampoule and vial secondary packaging trays protect glass pharmaceutical primary containers — ampoules (1mL to 30mL), injection vials (2mL to 100mL), and lyophilised vials — during secondary packaging, distribution, and storage. The PETG thermoformed tray provides individual cavity support for each glass container, protecting it from glass-to-glass contact that causes chipping and breakage, and maintaining each container in an upright, label-visible orientation for automated inspection and dispensing.

strips.title: Glass-to-Glass Contact — Chipping and Breakage in Pharmaceutical Secondary Packaging
strips.desc: Problem: Ampoules and vials without individual tray cavities contact each other during distribution vibration — glass-to-glass contact causes chipping, particulate generation, and container breakage. Broken glass pharmaceutical primary containers are a serious patient safety event. Solution: PETG tray with individual cavity for each ampoule or vial — no glass-to-glass contact at any packing density.

strips.title: Label Orientation for Automated Pharmaceutical Inspection
strips.desc: Problem: Ampoule and vial secondary packaging trays that do not maintain label-visible orientation prevent automated optical inspection of filled containers — inspection line reject or manual inspection required. Solution: Label window design in PETG cavity — each ampoule and vial in label-visible orientation for automated inspection compatibility.

strips.title: Lyophilised Vial Upright Position — Stopper Must Not Be Displaced
strips.desc: Problem: Lyophilised vial secondary packaging where the vial is not in an upright position at all times risks stopper displacement from the vial neck under stack loads — loss of sterile closure integrity. Solution: PETG cavity geometry maintains lyophilised vials in upright position at all standard pallet stack orientations.

sections.st: Ampoule & Vial Trays — Key Design Requirements

strips.title: Individual Cavity — No Glass-to-Glass Contact Mandatory
strips.desc: Individual PETG cavity for each ampoule or vial — cavity diameter matched to container body diameter. No ampoule-to-ampoule or vial-to-vial contact at any packing density, vibration level, or stack orientation.

strips.title: Label Window Design — Automated Inspection Compatible
strips.desc: Label-visible orientation with label window gap in cavity wall — the printed label on the ampoule or vial is visible from the tray top in each cavity position. Automated inspection line optical access confirmed from inspection system specification.

strips.title: Lyophilised Vial Geometry — Upright at All Orientations
strips.desc: Lyophilised vial cavity designed to maintain upright position under all standard secondary packaging orientations — pallet stacking, carton stacking, and distribution vibration. Cavity geometry prevents vial tipping.

strips.title: GMP Documentation Per Batch — Pharmaceutical Supplier Qualification
strips.desc: Batch records, material CoA with pharma-grade PETG specification, dimensional inspection per batch — available for pharmaceutical manufacturer supplier qualification programmes.
